delivered_contracts: Every fixed BJT history lane reserves fallibly before model bias evaluation; empty families allocate no lane storage.
Owned per-device UIC solution seeds use the same IC transformation with a fallible copy policy, preserving typed allocator errors.
Transient reinitialization prepares BJT state before changing capacitor, inductor or accepted junction history and before taking phase owners.
Shooting state installation reserves its BJT lanes before mutation; bias initialization prepares replacement history first.
HB BJT history reconstruction reserves all three generations before installing accepted periodic bias.
Transient resume uses the validated restored BJT history instead of allocating and evaluating a replacement that would be discarded.
Public GP/VBIC OP/UIC runs remain reusable after injected early/late initialization failures; capture/restore error tests still target their intended phases.
The stale classic-MOS refusal fixture is replaced by a positive zero-charge creation/resume test while the missing GP periodic-phase capability remains explicitly refused.
unchanged_contracts: No device equations, event clocks, numerical tolerances, phase model semantics or checkpoint encoding changed.
The native transport-record byte quota remains separate from fixed device-state lanes.
No device family or whole work package is newly declared complete.
open_evidence: C03b typed per-site delay-record ceiling diagnostics remain unimplemented.
C03c needs the remaining model/configuration/target cases and measured cancellation, memory and performance evidence.

C00-C14 remain open. Scoped unit/integration checks and recorded oracles are not final qualification of every model/analysis.
retention: Raw logs are ignored local artifacts. Per-run hashes, commands and outcomes are retained. Overlapping unit runs and the resolved failed attempt are not added to the unique passing total. Test duration is not a benchmark.
